definitions.explanation: The back surface or rear side of an object, building, or body. A formal or technical term.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背面|はいめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The camera is on the back of the smartphone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背面|はいめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a parking lot behind the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背面|はいめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}して→渡す：02442_watasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please sign the back of the card before handing it to the clerk.

notes:
Composed of {背|はい} (back) + ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (surface, side). A formal, somewhat technical term used in product descriptions, architecture, and anatomy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背面|はいめん}⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧ (rear camera)
- {背面|はいめん}⟦パネル→パネル：08840_paneru⟧ (back panel)
- {背面|はいめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}する→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧ (print on the back)
- {背面|はいめん}{飛|と}び (backward dive, Fosbury flop)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裏面|りめん}→裏面：18245_rimen⟧ — reverse side, back (more commonly used for flat objects like cards and paper)
- ⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧ — back side, reverse side (more colloquial)
- ⟦{後方|こうほう}→後方：19126_kouhou⟧ — rear, behind (refers to direction/position rather than a surface)
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧ — front, facade (the opposite: the front-facing side)
